visibleTestCases.title: Create Session Map
visibleTestCases.expectedOutput: #{login_count => 0, presence => offline, role => admin, user_id => alice}
visibleTestCases.explanation: Initializes map with offline presence and 0 logins.

visibleTestCases.title: Update Presence with Exact Matching
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin S = map_registry:create_session(alice, admin), map_registry:update_presence(S, alice, online) end
visibleTestCases.expectedOutput: #{login_count => 1, presence => online, role => admin, user_id => alice}
visibleTestCases.explanation: Matches alice and increments login_count to 1.

visibleTestCases.title: Reject Mismatched User Update
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin S = map_registry:create_session(alice, admin), map_registry:update_presence(S, bob, online) end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Returns error when session belongs to a different user.

visibleTestCases.title: Verify Admin Online Session
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin S = map_registry:create_session(alice, admin), S2 = map_registry:update_presence(S, alice, online), map_registry:is_admin_session(S2) end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Returns true for active online admin.
